propositions: Jira DC's unindexed issues are not visible to JQL searches, causing recover_pending to unbind a live keyless-pending create and dispatch_one.create_one to dedup-search and miss, creating a duplicate issue.
recover_pending must not unbind on a single negative search; it must require both search_miss_count >= 3 AND entry age exceeding a grace period (default 3600s) to corroborate true absence.

The create gate in dispatch_one.create_one must defer (not issue) the create when a keyless-pending binding for that local_id exists and is younger than the grace window, not rely only on get_jira_key() being None.
recover_pending must record search misses on keyless-pending entries and leave them pending until corroboration, then not count unresolved pending entries as resolved in its return value.

Once the index catches up and search returns the live issue, the pending binding must confirm against the existing issue without creating a duplicate, and genuinely-absent tickets must still unbind after corroboration and re-create.
